# UX Checklist: Landing Page Top Navigation

**Purpose**: Validate the quality, clarity, and completeness of UX-facing requirements for the landing page top navigation feature.
**Created**: 2026-08-26
**Feature**: specs/001-landing-page-navigation/spec.md

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are requirements explicit about all mandatory top navigation elements (title, topic menus, settings action) on initial entry? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements defined for how the system behaves when no menu items are configured, including expected user-visible outcomes? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements defined for how user feedback is presented after menu selection, beyond stating that feedback occurs in one interaction step? [Completeness, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-009]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK004 Is "top navigation area" sufficiently defined to avoid ambiguity about boundaries and placement of contained controls? [Clarity, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK005 Is "at the end of the top navigation area" precise enough to be interpreted consistently across responsive layouts and writing directions? [Clarity, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK006 Is "selected menu context" on the Coming Soon page defined with specific required content cues so reviewers can distinguish contexts objectively? [Clarity, Spec §User Story 2, Spec §FR-005]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK007 Do requirements for first-level menu scope align consistently across user stories, FR-007, and assumptions about deferred submenus? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §FR-007, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK008 Are requirements for placeholder behavior consistent between acceptance scenarios and FR-005 for all menu selections? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 2, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK009 Are "setting" versus "settings" terms used consistently enough to avoid interpretation drift in downstream artifacts? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK010 Can SC-002 be objectively measured with a defined usability-check method, participant profile, and success threshold interpretation? [Measurability, Ambiguity, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK011 Can SC-004 be objectively measured with a defined survey instrument and decision threshold for "communicates clearly"? [Measurability, Ambiguity, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK012 Are acceptance criteria traceably mapped to each functional requirement so coverage gaps are detectable? [Traceability, Gap, Spec §FR-001..FR-009, Spec §SC-001..SC-004]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK013 Are alternate-flow requirements defined for switching between different menus after a Coming Soon state is already shown? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 2]
- [ ] CHK014 Are exception-flow requirements defined for temporarily unavailable menu targets, including expected UX messaging and state behavior? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK015 Are recovery-flow requirements defined for returning to a stable navigation state after a failed menu-target transition? [Coverage, Recovery, Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements (Accessibility Focus)

- [ ] CHK016 Are keyboard navigation requirements explicitly specified for all interactive top navigation elements, including menu items and settings action? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §Constraints, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK017 Are focus visibility and focus-order requirements defined for the top navigation and Coming Soon transition states? [Non-Functional, Gap, Spec §Constraints]
- [ ] CHK018 Are semantic labeling requirements defined so topic menus and settings action are distinguishable for assistive technologies? [Non-Functional, Gap, Spec §User Story 3, Spec §FR-006]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK019 Is the assumption that Coming Soon is acceptable validated with stakeholders and linked to any dependency constraints? [Assumption, Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK020 Are assumptions about landing-entry access documented with boundaries for deep-link or refresh behavior expectations? [Assumption, Gap, Spec §Assumptions]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK021 Is the requirement scope boundary between "placeholder content" and "excluded markdown topic detail rendering" clear enough to prevent conflicting interpretations? [Ambiguity, Conflict, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK022 Are terms such as "clearly available" and "visually differentiated" quantified with criteria that different reviewers would score consistently? [Ambiguity, Measurability, Spec §User Story 3]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
- Add comments or findings inline.
- Link to relevant resources or documentation.
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference.
